description.narrative: 3one4 Capital IFSC - Fund V (Fund V or the Fund) is targeted to be a US$225 million, India focused venture capital (VC) fund. The Fund will focus primarily on seed to series A stage investments in Indian technology-enabled companies across sectors such as AI and Software (including SaaS), Enterprise & Manufacturing Automation, Fintech, Deeptech, and Consumer Internet.

Expected development impact through: (i) Increased access to seed-stage equity alongside operational value add for tech start-ups in India; (ii) Improving market competitiveness in the real, financial and digital sectors in India by catalyzing market-wide innovation through the expansion of investees with innovative business models via demonstration, replication, and/or competition and innovation channels.
